modules.name: Visitor Entry
modules.description: Handles expected and walk-in visitor entry and exit recording by the Watchman, with resident pre-registration and notifications.

requirements.title: Resident pre-registers expected visitor
requirements.description: Resident can add a visitor with name, mobile, date and purpose. Advance entry is optional and independent of the walk-in flow.

requirements.title: Today's Visitors list for Watchman
requirements.description: Expected visitors appear in the Watchman's Today's Visitors list on the day of the visit.

requirements.title: Find expected visitor by name, mobile or pass code
requirements.description: Watchman can find an expected visitor by name, mobile or pass code.

requirements.title: Allow Entry action saves entry time
requirements.description: Watchman taps Allow Entry for an expected visitor and the entry time is saved.

requirements.title: Exit action saves exit time
requirements.description: When the visitor leaves, Watchman taps Exit and the exit time is saved.

requirements.title: Watchman adds walk-in visitor
requirements.description: Watchman can add a walk-in visitor with name, mobile, flat, purpose and an optional photo. Entry and exit times are saved.

requirements.title: Information notification to resident on walk-in
requirements.description: The resident receives an information notification when a walk-in visitor entry is saved.

requirements.title: Call resident from the app
requirements.description: Watchman can tap to call the resident from the app to confirm a visitor.

requirements.title: Alert Society Manager on blocked entry
requirements.description: When entry is blocked because of a wrong flat number or no approved resident, the Society Manager is alerted.

requirements.title: Offline saving of visitor records
requirements.description: With a weak network, visitor records are saved on the phone and sent when the network returns.

rules.title: Walk-in entry needs no resident approval
rules.description: A walk-in visitor's entry is saved at once without resident approval.

rules.title: Wrong-date expected visitor treated as walk-in
rules.description: An expected visitor who arrives on the wrong date is handled as a walk-in.

rules.title: Block entry for wrong flat or no approved resident
rules.description: Entry is blocked if the flat number is wrong or the flat has no approved resident.

rules.title: Unrecorded exit marked at midnight
rules.description: If an exit is not recorded, the visit is marked Exit Not Recorded at midnight.
